traits.inflorescence.note: The Flora of North America's account of the genus, as quoted in search results (the page itself was not read): inflorescences terminal on long shoots, erect or pendulous, 10 to 100 or more flowered panicles.

traits.note: Jepson's Manual of the Flowering Plants of California (1925), read in full: petals 5; stamens 20 on a ring-like perigynous disk; pistils 5, distinct. Jepson eFlora (as quoted in search results; the page itself was not read): hypanthium saucer-shaped; pistils 5, ovaries superior; stamens 15 to 20.
